title: 2nd-order underdamped step response (scaffold's worked exemplar)

governing_equations.name: normalized 2nd-order ODE
governing_equations.expr: x'' + 2 zeta omega_n x' + omega_n^2 x = omega_n^2 u(t)
governing_equations.description: Mass-spring-damper / RLC / servo prototype with damping ratio zeta and natural frequency omega_n; unit step command.

governing_equations.name: peak overshoot (gate ground truth)
governing_equations.description: Closed-form fractional overshoot of the underdamped step response.

governing_equations.name: peak time (gate ground truth)
governing_equations.description: Time of the first response maximum.

assumptions: Linear, time-invariant, single degree of freedom; constant coefficients.
Underdamped regime 0 <= zeta < 1 (enforced — evaluate refuses otherwise).
Zero initial conditions; ideal unit step input.

sources.title: K. Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th ed., sec. 5-3 (transient response of 2nd-order systems)
sources.used_for: overshoot Mp and peak-time tp closed forms (gates 1-2)

sources.title: S. S. Rao, Mechanical Vibrations, 6th ed., ch. 2 (free vibration of SDOF systems)
sources.used_for: undamped natural period 2*pi/omega_n (gate 3) and the damped frequency relation

discretization.notes: default dt = T_d/400; convergence receipt compares dt vs dt/2.

validation.ground_truth: overshoot_vs_closed_form: Mp = exp(-pi*zeta/sqrt(1-zeta^2)) at zeta=0.2 (Ogata 5-3); peak_time_vs_closed_form: tp = pi/(omega_n*sqrt(1-zeta^2)) at zeta=0.2 (Ogata 5-3); undamped_period: T = 2*pi/omega_n between consecutive undamped peaks (Rao ch. 2)
validation.direction: inline self-check gates re-run on EVERY invocation (refuse-before-run); no committed pin unless pin_file is set

caveats: settling_time_2pct_s is the LAST 2%-band exit found on the sampled trajectory (dt-quantized).
Derived model: validation_status is synthesized_inloop, never 'validated' — graduation needs a committed pin per docs/MANIFEST_SCHEMA.md.

limits_of_validity.regime: underdamped 0 <= zeta < 1 ONLY — the gates' closed forms do not exist at zeta >= 1 and the model refuses
limits_of_validity.resolution: outputs quoted from a trajectory sampled at dt; peak/settling times are dt-quantized (receipt carries dt)
